snippet.title: My Arms Are Longer Now | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Join hands with Matt and Millie from Toot Games as they talk through a brand-new trailer for this 2D stealth-comedy marvel. Learn what it takes to be the long arm of the unlawful and get a first look at the game’s stupendously detailed arm customisation. What a flex!

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646170/My_Arms_Are_Longer_Now/

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration
